sources.title: Open-Meteo daily precipitation (forecast past_days and ERA5 archive)

provenance.note: Open-Meteo daily precipitation summed over 2026-06-25 to 2026-07-25 for 589 Gram Panchayats, queried at the bounding-box centre of each TNGIS polygon (from the directory). No normal was computed on this run, so anomaly fields are null.

conventions.measurement: modelled reanalysis interpolated to a grid point inside the Panchayat, not a rain gauge; gridOffsetKm is the distance from the queried centroid to the returned grid cell
conventions.window: 30 days ending on the acquisition date, matching the profile's current-rainfall limit
